=== DOCS-TRUTH VERIFIED (2026-06-08 via WebFetch trino.io/docs/467/functions/{string,conditional,array,conversion}.html) ===

• STRING (a): split_part(string, delimiter, index) → varchar, 1-based fields, NULL when index > number of fields (NOT empty string). substr/substring 1-based, negative-start counts from end. position(sub IN str) + strpos(str, sub) both 1-based, 0-if-not-found. strpos 3-arg form exists for n-th occurrence. concat_ws(separator, string1, ..., stringN) → varchar (NULL strings skipped; NULL separator → NULL). regexp_replace, trim/ltrim/rtrim, lpad/rpad, upper, lower, replace, length all present.
• FORMAT (b): format(format_string, args...) → varchar uses Java Formatter syntax (%s, %d, %,d, %.2f, %,.2f, %%). try_cast(value AS type) → type returns NULL on cast failure. format_number(number) → varchar EXISTS in Trino 467 as SINGLE-ARG unit-symbol formatter (returns '123K', '1M', etc.) — NOT Spark's 2-arg format_number(x, decimals). No implicit numeric→varchar coercion in concat/||.
• CONDITIONAL (c): if(condition, true_value) 2-arg → returns NULL when false. if(condition, true_value, false_value) 3-arg → standard ternary. coalesce(value1, value2[, ...]) multi-arg first-non-null. nullif(value1, value2) 2-arg returns NULL if equal. greatest/least scalar multi-arg row-wise; return NULL if ANY arg NULL (matches Oracle/MySQL/BigQuery; PostgreSQL ignores NULLs — outlier).
• HOF / ARRAY (d): filter(array(T), function(T, boolean)) → array(T) — keeps elements where lambda is true. reduce(array(T), initialState S, inputFunction(S, T, S), outputFunction(S, R)) → R — 4-arg fold to scalar. transform(array(T), function(T, U)) → array(U) — element-wise lambda. array_join(x, delimiter) → varchar AND array_join(x, delimiter, null_replacement) → varchar — array→string idiom. concat_ws supports BOTH variadic-varchar form AND single-array form in Trino 467.
